trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of tbl:particle-nf-table-table-data (legend paragraph plus a 10-row H_3(q) normal-form table). No constructions from the ten categories. VERIFIED THE ALGEBRA independently in sympy: with h = q - 1/q, the e+ row sigma_0^-1 sigma_1^-1 sigma_0^-1 expands to e- + h^2(sigma_0+sigma_1) - h(L+ + L-) - (h^3+h)gamma, i.e. exactly the tabulated -0.218 / +0.044 / +0.044 / -0.209 / -0.209 / +1, and its net 1 - h^3 + 2h^2 - 3h = 0.451094 reproduces the tabulated +0.451 (the naive sum of the ROUNDED cells gives 0.452, so the table is right and a spot-check by adding the printed cells is not).
trap-negation-contrast.notes: PIN NOTE: at 3 dp these entries cannot discriminate the proton pin 1.1099785827513808 (net 0.451094288) from the muon pin 1.10997859555733471 (0.451094234) - they differ at the 8th decimal - nor from the 6-digit truncation 1.10997 (0.451130). They DO exclude the erroneous 1.1097, which gives net 0.452253. NOT A TRAP, reported separately: the Knot column labels do not survive a closure computation - sigma_0 sigma_1 is labelled 'Hopf T(2,2)' but closes in B_3 to the unknot, and sigma_0 sigma_1 sigma_0 is labelled 'trefoil 3_1' but closes to the 2-component Hopf link; T(2,q) is a 2-strand symbol, so the words should be sigma_0^2 and sigma_0^3. This is the documented 'torus words written with p generators instead of p-1' family; braid-word-closure-check.ts cannot see these rows because the column is headed 'Hecke word' rather than 'braid word'.
